name: MoonHack
source:
MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world.

Set in the year 2125, AI has optimized everything—labor, taxation, romance, emotions, even the choices that shape the future. In this world, even "loving what you love" is considered a crime.

Alongside girls whose humanity has been classified as a crime, the player infiltrates a digital world governed by AI-enforced laws. Through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten. Narrative sequences intertwine with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized to vocal performances, transforming music itself into the power of hacking.

This is the girls' hack—a rebellion against a future that has become too perfect.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4915490/MoonHack/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
MoonHack是一款情感网络黑色冒险游戏，其中歌曲改写了世界规则。

以2125年为背景，人工智能优化了一切——劳动力、税收、浪漫、情感，甚至塑造未来的选择。在这个世界上，连“爱你所爱的”都被认为是犯罪。

玩家与人性被列为犯罪的女孩一起渗透到由人工智能执行的法律管辖的数字世界。通过歌曲，控制幸福的系统背后的规则将被改写。叙事序列与与声乐表演同步的3D节奏动作游戏交织在一起，将音乐本身转化为黑客的力量。

这是女孩们的黑客行为——对已经变得过于完美的未来的反抗。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4915490/MoonHack/]Steam[/url]]
